text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tourism to Malta drops by 62,183 in 1996, a decrease of 5.6 percent over 1995. The drop was steepest in the British market, which accounts for nearly half of Malta's tourist arrivals.
- Prime Minister promises wage increases if cost of living rises.
- Minister's driver in court over illegal gambling.

- White Paper on new taxes causing uncertainty. The proposed new system replaces VAT with a system of customs duties at 15 percent and a five per cent duty on products, while eliminating tax from several services. There is uncertainty over what is taxable or not and whether prices will go up.
